# PubMed

> PubMed is the free search interface to MEDLINE and 40M+ biomedical literature citations maintained by the National Library of Medicine (NLM) and National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI).

PubMed provides comprehensive access to peer-reviewed biomedical and life sciences literature through multiple search tools, data download options, and citation management features. The platform integrates MeSH indexing, advanced filtering, and specialized search modes for clinical research discovery.

## Key Topics

- MEDLINE
- NCBI
- National Library of Medicine (NLM)
- MeSH
- PubMed Central
- Biomedical literature
- Citation search

- E-utilities API
- Data download

- JSON output
- Clinical queries
- Literature search
- Citation database

## Core Search & Discovery

- [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov): PubMed homepage: 40M+ biomedical literature citations from MEDLINE
- [Advanced Search Results - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/advanced): Advanced search interface with filters, saved searches, and alerts
- [Clinical Queries - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinical): Specialized search tool for clinical studies and COVID-19 content

## Citation Tools & Lookup

- [Single Citation Matcher - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/citmatch): Citation lookup tool for journal/author searches with JSON output
- [Batch Citation Matcher - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/batchcitmatch): Bulk PMID retrieval tool with file upload and JSON output

## Citation Management & Collections

- [Clipboard - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clipboard): Citation management tool: clipboard, bibliography, collections

## Data Access & Download

- [Download Data - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/download): MEDLINE data download via FTP, E-utilities, baseline files

## Information & Support

- [About - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/about): PubMed service overview by NCBI/NLM/NIH
- [Help - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/help): User guide covering search techniques, Boolean operators, basics

## Optional

- [Disclaimer - PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/disclaimer): Legal disclaimer on PubMed, PMC, and Bookshelf content policy
